import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=cameras, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', s=100, palette='deep')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type and Video Capability', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video Capability', loc='upper left', fontsize=10)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
